analysis_settings.smoothing: Centered coordinate median within consecutive valid runs; missing values remain missing
analysis_settings.body_reference: Fixed midpoint of front and rear trunk landmarks; both required
analysis_settings.head_and_paw_reference: Torso-centred, rotated into the torso image-plane axis
analysis_settings.tail_reference: Tip minus base for translation; angular oscillation measured relative to torso
analysis_settings.displacement_definition: Distance between consecutive valid observations, not endpoint displacement
analysis_settings.quality_denominator: All received frames/pairs in the interval; temporal gaps also reduce observed time

limitations: All positions and angles are 2D projections; occlusion and viewpoint affect measurements.
Camera motion and zoom are not estimated or corrected; body displacement is movement in the image.
Image-diagonal normalization handles image resizing, not camera distance or real-world scale.
Landmark likelihood is a model score, not a calibrated probability of correct behavior recognition.
Rule thresholds are engineering starting values, not validated feline behavior standards.
Median smoothing and isolated-spike filtering can suppress real rapid movements; estimates depend on these settings.
These measurements cannot establish gaze, attention, emotion, intent, health, contact, or licking.
